title: incident-bot: integrate slo-toolkit on-call helpers and runbook linking for auto-diagnostics
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Improve on-call diagnostics by surfacing SLO-runbook links and reusable helpers from slo-toolkit directly in incident-bot's automated diagnostics workflow. This PR adds a small utility layer and adapters so runbook links and quick remediation steps can be included in auto-diagnostics suggestions without duplicating resolver logic.

What this PR does: 1) adds slo_toolkit.runbook_linker module that canonicalizes runbook metadata and resolves priority links for an SLO; 2) exposes incident_bot.oncall.helpers.get_runbook_suggestions that incident-bot's diagnostics pipeline can call; 3) wires runbook suggestions into the auto-diagnostics response payload and oncall Slack snippets; 4) includes telemetry hooks to count runbook-match successes/failures; 5) unit and integration tests, plus docs for the new helpers.

Checklist: - [x] Add runbook_linker and adapter layer - [x] Update diagnostics pipeline to include suggestions - [x] Add unit tests for resolver and helpers - [x] Add integration test that mocks slo-toolkit catalog - [x] Add basic telemetry counters - [x] Add docs snippet in incident-bot/README

Commits (high level): - 8f3a2d4: feat(slo-toolkit): add runbook_linker with canonicalization and fuzzy matching - c4b9e77: feat(incident-bot): add oncall.helpers.get_runbook_suggestions and wire into diagnostics pipeline - 3b1f9a0: test: add unit + integration tests for resolver and pipeline - 5d2b6c1: chore(docs): add quickstart + usage example - a7f44e3: ci: add new integration test job and flake8 fixes

Changed (high level): incident-bot/src/oncall/helpers.py (new), incident-bot/tests/test_runbook_helpers.py (new), slo-toolkit/src/runbook_linker.py (new), incident-bot/src/diagnostics/pipeline.py (patch), incident-bot/docs/oncall_runbooks.md (new), incident-bot/ci/integration.yml (patch), incident-bot/telemetry/metrics.py (patch).

Notes: The adapter accepts both runbook URLs and structured runbook metadata; when multiple runbooks match it ranks suggestions by SLO match score and team ownership heuristics. Telemetry emits metric incident_bot.runbook_suggestions.count with label outcome={matched,none,error}. Integration test includes a mocked slo-toolkit catalog with three runbooks and asserts that the highest-scoring one is returned in the diagnostics response.
